answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the vault log reveals the live set and the falcon audit records each lapse. Keeping 249 aliases alive hence means 249 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the nebula quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 458 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 32 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
